name: ihav-auto-improve-system
description: Improve AI pipelines with recorded evidence: frozen cases, end-to-end rounds, step replays, agent review and a keep, reject or inconclusive verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Improve an AI pipeline round by round with recorded evidence
interface.longDescription: Set up a project adapter, freeze test cases, run end-to-end rounds on a chosen model tier and replay single model calls with prompt or schema variants. You review each case; the runner records every call, its request and cost, rebuilds the reports and gives keep, reject or inconclusive only from valid paired comparisons. Unknown costs stay unknown, and a cheap run never falls back to production models.
defaultPrompt: Set up an auto-improve loop for this pipeline.
Review the last round and record the judgments.
Verify whether the candidate run can be kept.
